name: Selhorst Woodworks | Las Vegas/San Diego | Accent Walls and Ceilings, Barn Doors, Shelving, Beams
old_description: Selhorst Woodworks was built on a shared vision between husband-and-wife team Matthew and Chantel Selhorst: to create exceptional spaces through thoughtful design, expert craftsmanship, and an unwavering commitment to quality.
about:
Selhorst Woodworks operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where husband-and-wife team Matthew and Chantel Selhorst founded the company on a shared vision to create exceptional spaces through thoughtful design and expert craftsmanship. The business identifies as family-owned and grew from a passion for woodworking into a custom finish carpentry operation serving the Las Vegas area.

The shop produces custom architectural woodwork including accent walls and ceilings, barn doors, shelving, built-ins, mudrooms, beams, baseboards, and crown molding. It also offers wallpaper installation and design services, and works with specialty materials such as Thermory thermally modified wood and Renson products. The company describes its approach as delivering meticulous attention to detail from consultation through final installation.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, builders, and architects who value timeless design and craftsmanship. Projects range from residential upgrades to custom millwork for new construction, with the team emphasizing seamless integration of custom features into existing or new spaces.

The founders state that the company was built on an unwavering commitment to quality and the belief that the smallest details make the biggest impact. They position the business around a family-first philosophy, treating each project with the same care they would apply to their own home, and aim to create spaces that are both beautifully designed and built to be enjoyed for years.

name: Sentinel Solar
old_description: Sentinel Solar specializes in premium residential solar + storage systems designed for performance, resilience, and longevity. We handle everything from permitting to utility approval, and we build systems we'd put on our own homes.
about:
Sentinel Solar is based in Covington, Kentucky, and serves customers across Kentucky and Ohio. The company was founded by Jan Thurman, who brought over a decade of coast-to-coast experience in residential and commercial solar to establish a firm built on the conviction that solar should be done right or not at all.

The company designs and installs custom solar-plus-storage systems for homes and businesses, handling every step from permitting and utility approval to final commissioning. Its services include residential solar with battery backup, commercial solar arrays, EV charger installation, and generator integration. All work is performed by Sentinel's own crews rather than subcontractors, and recent projects include installations at a private residence in Fort Mitchell, Kentucky, and at Wenzel Distillery and ProMaster in Cincinnati, Ohio.

Sentinel Solar serves residential homeowners and commercial clients in sectors such as hospitality, manufacturing, and retail. The company emphasizes long-term relationships over volume, positioning itself as a premium provider rather than a high-volume installer.

Thurman founded the business to offer a local, accountable alternative to national franchises. The company cites four guiding principles: a consultative, non-transactional sales approach; local accountability with a team that lives in the community; installer-first quality that prioritizes safe, correct installation; and a referral-driven model that depends on long-term customer satisfaction.

name: Servall Uniform & Linen Supply
old_description: A professional appearance is the groundwork for your reputation. It affects your staff every day, from attitude and team spirit to quality of work. At Servall Uniform & Linen Supply, we are dedicated to making sure your business looks its best while upholding comfort and safety at the same time. Because we’re not only serving you, we’re serving the community that relies on you. When clean cannot be compromised, count on your partners at Servall Uniform & Linen Supply for dependable linen rentals and uniform services.
about:
Servall Uniform & Linen Supply was founded in 1938 in Rapid City, South Dakota. From its start serving hometown businesses, the company has grown to operate across a two-state region, with physical locations in Chamberlain, South Dakota, and Gillette, Wyoming (and an office in Cheyenne, Wyoming). The business remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides uniform rental and direct purchase, linen rental, industrial laundry services, restroom and sanitation supplies, janitorial products, first aid kits, dust control mats, towel and bedding programs, hand sanitizer stations, and ice melt. Servall manages scheduled pickup and delivery for its rental programs, serving hundreds of customers throughout western South Dakota and eastern Wyoming from its regional facilities.

Customers include healthcare providers such as Spearfish Canyon Healthcare, hospitality landmarks like Wall Drug, publishing operations such as Ravellette Publications, financial institutions including First Interstate Bank, and independent retailers like Alternative Fuel Coffee House. The company’s service area covers communities from Spearfish, Custer, and Hot Springs in South Dakota to Sheridan, Gillette, and Buffalo in Wyoming.

Servall emphasizes reliable, locally based service and the convenience of consolidated facility supply programs. Its stated mission is to provide dedicated, professional service that delivers cost value and enhanced productivity within weeks, backed by long-tenured delivery representatives who build ongoing relationships with client sites.

name: Service Electric Cable TV & Communications - Bethlehem HQ
old_description: An affordable alternative to traditional cable television at only $19.95 per month with hundreds of live bonus channels and NO network fees, cable TV fees, sports channel fees or rental fees!  Bonus channels include more than 70 Spanish language channels, 40+ true crime options, music, news, weather, kids channels and much more!
about:
Service Electric Cable TV & Communications traces its roots to 1948 in Mahanoy City, Pennsylvania, where John Walson Sr. (born John Walsonavich) invented cable television to bring broadcast signals to his appliance-store customers in the mountains. The company moved its headquarters to 2200 Avenue A in Bethlehem in 2014 and remains a third-generation, family-owned business now led by John M. Walson, grandson of the founder.

The company operates as a regional telecommunications provider delivering broadband internet (up to Gig+ speeds with eero whole-home WiFi), cable television with hundreds of channels including local sports networks such as the Service Electric Network (SEN) and SEN+ streaming app, and voice services. It also runs a dedicated business division — Service Electric Business — supplying internet, phone, and TV to small, medium, and enterprise customers with a promise of free local, same-day service calls. Service territory spans the Lehigh Valley, Hunterdon County (NJ), and Wilkes-Barre (PA).

Customers include residential subscribers and businesses across northeastern Pennsylvania and western New Jersey. The business unit serves commercial offices, hospitality, healthcare, and education facilities that require managed connectivity, static IPs, and priority support. Partnerships with PenTeleData and Alianza extend the portfolio to hosted voice and advanced broadband solutions.

The Walson family emphasizes community involvement and local ownership as differentiators: the company was the first in the nation to carry HBO (1972), a founding partner of the Lehigh Valley IronPigs and Phantoms, and operates the hyper-local Service Electric Network covering high school and collegiate sports, Musikfest, and regional news.

name: Service Metal Fabricators
old_description: Service Metal Fabricators is a one-stop shop providing comprehensive precision sheet metal fabrication services for over 40 years. As a full-service fabricator specializing in NEMA and other electronic enclosures, brackets, panels and assemblies, along with stainless steel medical containers, our services have proven integral to a wide range of customers in various industries. Our enclosures often house the printed circuit boards and other internal electronic data processing, controlling and actuating parts for products serving unique purposes in the electronics, industrials, diagnostic/measurement and various other industries.
about:
Service Metal Fabricators, based in Williamsburg, Virginia, has operated for over 40 years as a precision sheet metal fabricator. The company began as a specialist in electronic enclosures and has grown into a full-service shop serving a broad base of technology-focused customers.

The shop produces NEMA-rated enclosures, brackets, panels, assemblies, and stainless-steel medical containers. Its capabilities span shearing, CNC punching, press brake forming, vertical milling, CNC machining, MIG/TIG and spot welding, riveting, hardware insertion, silk screening, chemical finishing, powder coating, and painting. Operations run from a 12-acre campus with 56,000 to 60,000 square feet of manufacturing space, supported by a production workforce that includes three quality-assurance professionals for every 25 production employees.

Customers come from electronics, industrial equipment, diagnostic and measurement, medical, aerospace, military, TEMPEST computing, solar energy, and transportation sectors. Notable programs include enclosures for Becton Dickinson’s laboratory blood analyzers, chassis for a $15 billion transportation company’s electronics division, components for a solar smart-circuitry venture, and helm stations installed on the bridges of a dozen U.S. aircraft carriers.

The company differentiates itself through vertical integration that includes its own delivery fleet, offering free shipping within 200 miles, and machine redundancy to protect lead times. It also provides design engineering, design-for-manufacturability guidance, and reverse-engineering support, while maintaining adherence to military and industry standards such as AMS-STD-1595, MIL-DTL-5541, and RoHS.

name: Seven Trees Woodworking
old_description: Our owner, Jarin Smoker, has forever loved beautiful millwork. His passion became his livelihood when he founded Seven Trees Woodworking in 2009. Since our inception, Seven Trees has grown to include a team of skilled individuals who love turning raw wood into beautiful millwork pieces.
about:
Seven Trees Woodworking is based in New Holland, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 2009 by Jarin Smoker. Smoker’s long‑standing passion for fine millwork led him to start the company, which has since grown into a team of skilled craftsmen dedicated to turning raw wood into finished architectural pieces.

The shop produces architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, custom doors, commercial millwork, private‑label and white‑label furniture, and metalwork. Operations run from a facility on King Court, where the team handles projects ranging from residential cabinetry to large‑scale commercial installations for restaurants and hotels.

Primary markets include the restaurant and hospitality sectors, as well as commercial, residential, and furniture‑brand clients. The company has supplied private‑label furniture for international brands and regularly works with architects and designers on custom projects for hotels, offices, and homes.

Seven Trees emphasizes a willingness to take on challenging projects that other shops decline, positioning itself as a problem‑solver for complex millwork and furniture requirements.

name: Severance Foods / Pan De Oro
old_description: Pan De Oro is a family owned and operated brand that has been producing delicious tortilla chips for almost 40 years.  Our attention to high-quality standards, all natural ingredients and unique flavors all play a key part in why our chips are so delicious!
about:
Severance Foods operates from Hartford, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1985 by three former Heublein food scientists — Richard Stevens, John Grikis, and Rich Dana. After R.J. Reynolds acquired Heublein in 1984, the trio used their severance packages to acquire a facility and equipment, launching a company to meet the Northeast's growing demand for tortillas and tortilla chips. The business remains family-owned and operated under the Pan De Oro brand.

The company manufactures tortilla chips and salsa under its own Pan De Oro label and provides co-packing services for other brands. Production emphasizes non-GMO, organic, and hand-crafted methods. The plant in Hartford is described as the largest tortilla chip manufacturer and co-packer in the Northeast, though specific facility size, headcount, and volume figures are not disclosed.

Customers include restaurants, schools, concession operators, and retail grocery stores across New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, as well as farmers markets throughout the region. The co-packing side serves other food brands seeking a regional production partner.

The founders started the business after their work on Ortega Mexican Foods at Heublein revealed an unmet need for Mexican-style products in the Northeast. They cite attention to high-quality standards, all-natural ingredients, and unique flavor development as the reasons their chips have gained traction since 1985.

Materials are native hardwoods such as cherry, maple, and oak, along with classic pine offered prefinished or ready for paint or stain. The brand differentiates itself with a “Proudly Made in Maine and Made in America” commitment, highlighting domestic production, timeless Shaker-inspired designs, and a hands-on shopping experience across two floors of inventory.

name: Sheet Metal Enterprises
old_description: We are a local family operated business located on the Boston / Dedham line. Conveniently located near I-95 for fast travel. Ask about our delivery service. We will drop off your order right at your job site.
about:
Sheet Metal Enterprises operates from Dedham, Massachusetts, on the Boston-Dedham line near I-95. The family-owned shop was founded by Ed, who brings over 30 years of HVAC and fabrication experience, including 22 years installing equipment in residential and commercial buildings. The company has been in business for more than a decade, positioned minutes from local HVAC supply houses.

The shop specializes in custom-fabricated HVAC ductwork and fittings, producing ducts in standard 4-foot and 8-foot lengths as well as precise custom sizes such as 74 3/4 inches. Beyond ductwork, it manufactures copper shower pans and other sheet metal products, including soldering brass strainers into the pans. The operation emphasizes quick turnaround for a custom fabrication facility.

Primary customers are HVAC contractors and installers working on new systems or replacements in both residential and commercial construction. Plumbing professionals also source copper shower pans. The company's proximity to supply houses and its job-site delivery service support contractors who need accurately sized ductwork on tight schedules.

Ed's field background informs the company's approach: he guides customers on sizing and duct design, offering practical installation insights. The business was built to make the procurement and installation process smoother, combining custom fabrication with direct delivery to the job site.

about: Sherven Sales, Inc. was founded in 1970 and has remained a family-owned and operated business in Wahpeton, North Dakota, for over five decades. The company specializes in grain systems, grain handling equipment, livestock equipment, and trailers, providing assembly and service for all products it sells. Its offerings cover grain bins and handling equipment, livestock feeding and handling equipment, and flatbed, enclosed, and stock trailers. The business combines product sales with hands-on assembly and ongoing service support, serving both new installations and existing equipment maintenance. Sherven Sales serves agricultural operations that require grain storage and handling systems, livestock producers needing feeding and handling equipment, and transport operations using flatbed, enclosed, and stock trailers. The company’s focus on assembly and service aims to support customers throughout the equipment lifecycle, from initial installation to maintenance and repair. The company distinguishes itself by offering assembly and service on every product line it carries, allowing customers to source equipment and installation from a single provider, a model rooted in its family-owned commitment to long-term customer relationships.
